impact: Low odds of passing for now, but rising bipartisan backlash over power bills is a policy risk for AI build-outs, touching BE, GOOGL, MSFT and NBIS; watch whether other Republicans sign on in the lame-duck session.
source: Politico via Political Wire / Unusual Whales
summary: Sen. Josh Hawley (R-Mo.) on Wednesday endorsed a temporary nationwide moratorium on data center construction until Congress passes a ratepayer 'bill of rights' guaranteeing no electricity rate increases, Politico reported. He is the highest-ranking Republican to back the idea, joining progressive Democrats such as Bernie Sanders. The Senate moratorium bill reportedly has no cosponsors yet.
title: Sen. Hawley backs nationwide pause on data center construction
